openIssues.additionalVisualConcern: Anti-Venom's targeted native rear post-swing view shows a red tongue segment beside the left upper arm. The root is occluded; front/side evidence is needed before deciding whether to apply a pose correction. See verification/targeted-anti-venom/review.json.
openIssues.finding: Poison's distal tongue hook is corrected with a pose-only rotation. Source bind matrices, hierarchy, weights and chain lengths are preserved. All 4196 frames leave the mouth, body, fingers and 2816 unaffected vertices exactly unchanged. Native front and grounded-rear views show the revised silhouette. The rear view is not a frame-matched deep crouch comparison.
openIssues.next: Review remaining symbiote poses as their batches are completed; extend corrective policies only when supported by visual evidence. Retain deep-crouch coverage as a remaining targeted visual check.

openIssues.finding: Weighted finger reach contracts under the fist policy, but several native captures show claw-like or incompletely closed free hands. Numeric contraction is not proof of a visually closed fist. Devil Spider's measurement now passes after recovering its actual body. Black Suit Swiney Girl still has no vertices predominantly weighted to the selected distal joints, leaving a metric coverage gap, not proof that preserved weights are damaged.
openIssues.next: Inspect and correct finger curl/orientation using representative hand geometry and native close views.

sourceLimitations.finding: Both source FBXs contain only the standard two arm chains. The 356 upper extra-arm vertices are weighted only to the collarbones; there are no independent extra-arm or extra-finger chains to retarget. The observed rest pose is authored source behavior, not dropped rig data.
sourceLimitations.resolution: Preserve source hierarchy and weights as requested. Independent extra-arm animation would require an explicitly authorized change to that source rig/weight policy.
